zh: 陳子昂悠悠的：前不見古人後不見來者
柳永喃喃的：楊柳岸曉風殘月
en: Chen Zi'ang's timeless lament: before me, no ancients; behind me, none to come
Liu Yong murmurs: willow-lined shore, dawn wind, waning moon
And now: rivers and lakes, misty rain, a single cup of wine

points.zh:
「前不見古人，後不見來者。念天地之悠悠，獨愴然而涕下！」
--陳子昂 《登幽州台歌》
「多情自古傷離別，更那堪冷落清秋節！今宵酒醒何處？楊柳岸，曉風殘月。此去經年，應是良辰好景虛設。便縱有千種風情，更與何人說？」
--柳永 《雨霖鈴》
「桃李春風一杯酒，江湖夜雨十年灯。」
--黄庭堅 《寄黄幾復》

en: This morning, the sky hazy and dim
Yellow leaves drift down
In the wind is the scent of coffee
The frog at the bottom of the well says
The sky is so desolate
Drifting clouds without words, unfurling at ease

zh: 去邊界，追尋傳説和軼事
en: Passing through oneself, as if
Captain Cook crosses latitude and longitude
Going to the border, chasing legends and anecdotes

points.zh: 詹姆斯·庫克（James Cook，1728年－1779年），人稱庫克船長（Captain Cook），英國皇家海軍軍官、航海家、探險家、製圖師。三度奉命遠航太平洋，是首批登陸澳洲東岸和夏威夷群島的歐洲人，也創下首次歐洲船隻環繞紐西蘭航行的紀錄。在數千公里的太平洋航程途中，深入不少地球上未為西方所知的地帶。透過測經儀，為紐西蘭與夏威夷之間的島嶼，繪製大量精準的地圖。在探索旅途中，庫克也為不少新發現的島嶼和事物命名。在歷次的航海旅程中，他展現出集合航海技術、測量和繪圖技術、逆境自強和危機處理的領導能力和才華。 1779年，在第三次探索太平洋期間，與夏威夷島上的島民發生打鬥，不幸遇害身亡。庫克對航海科學和地理學方面有重大貢獻，持續影響至20世紀。不少地方都建有紀念碑和雕像以表揚庫克的成就。不過，他的探索成就也影響西方國家後來對太平洋地區的殖民化，使當地原居民的生活方式和社會結構產生巨大轉變，這方面的影響一直都是政界和學術界的爭論焦點。       （ 取自維基百科）
points.en: James Cook (1728–1779), known as Captain Cook, was a British Royal Navy officer, navigator, explorer, and cartographer. He commanded three voyages to the Pacific Ocean, was among the first Europeans to land on the eastern coast of Australia and the Hawaiian Islands, and was the first to sail a European ship completely around New Zealand. Over thousands of kilometers of Pacific voyaging, he ventured deep into regions previously unknown to the West. Using a theodolite, he produced numerous accurate maps of the islands between New Zealand and Hawaii. In the course of his explorations, Cook also named many newly discovered islands and features. Across his voyages he displayed a combination of navigational skill, surveying and mapmaking ability, resilience in adversity, and leadership in crisis management. In 1779, during his third Pacific expedition, he was killed in a clash with islanders in Hawaii. Cook made major contributions to nautical science and geography that continued to influence the field into the 20th century, and monuments and statues have been erected in many places to honor his achievements. However, his explorations also paved the way for later Western colonization of the Pacific region, bringing about enormous change to the ways of life and social structures of the indigenous peoples there — an impact that remains a focus of debate in politics and academia to this day. (Adapted from Wikipedia)

zh: Captain Cook bronze statue.    Corner Brook, Newfoundland. （ 2017）
en: Captain Cook bronze statue.    Corner Brook, Newfoundland. ( 2017)
Snow, drifting
Drifting--------
White becomes blankness itself
The beach remains, the waves remain
The horizon and the setting sun are both there
When will you come walking in on the sea breeze

flow.caption_zh: 密西根湖落日.  Muskegon, Michigan.

en: Walking to where the water ends
Beneath the flowering tree
Sitting in meditation
"Who runs faster, the train or the rails?"
The grandchild asks, remembering only having once chased after
The sugar mill's narrow-gauge cart hauling cane

points.zh:
《 五分車 》 路寒袖
小小的五分車上
成綑成綑的甘蔗
堆得高比天
即使舉起全線通行的旗號
仍然不時絆倒出遊的雲彩
我童年唯一的零食
坐著五分車到處旅行
糖和油菜花混合的香味
飄過原野，迷惑了麻雀
緩緩傳進學校的每一扇窗
放學後，我常到鐵道旁等待
遠方五分車駕著風前來
偷偷抽一根，像拉開貧窮的門閂
苦澀的皮是父親的汗漬
甜膩的汁是我未長大的夢

en: Temple, the bell tolling slow
The black-robed priest walks past with bowed head
The shadow cast by the cross
A rainy night, idly tapping the chess pieces
Step by step, walking in
Sorrento, a landscape with song

points.zh:
黃梅時節家家雨， 青草池塘處處蛙。
有約不來過夜半， 閑敲棋子落燈花。
--宋。趙師秀《約客》
Sorrento ( 蘇連多 ) 濱臨地中海，是意大利南部最美的阿瑪菲海岸 ( Amalfi Coast ) 北邊一個小鎮。臨海懸崖，別墅林立，石板街道，幽靜閒舒。有海風處有林園，有波浪處有漁船，是夏日渡假之處。隔海可遙望維蘇威火山。Sorrento 因意大利民謠 “ Come back to Sorrento ”而聲名遠播。
《 Come back to Sorrento 》意大利民謠
《 歸來吧!  蘇連多 》    蕭而化作詞
聽那海洋的呼吸　　充滿了柔情蜜意
你的笑語和歌聲　　留在我的心底
園內陽光明媚無比　菊花到處放出香氣
對著這麼美的春光　叫我如何不想你
自從你和我別離　悲哀湧進我的心底
在這可愛的地方　數著你的歸期
歸來吧　歸來~　請不要把我忘記
歸來吧　歸來~    請不要把我忘記
points.en:
In the plum-rain season, every house has rain; frogs call everywhere in the green grass ponds.
A friend invited was expected but hasn't come, even past midnight; idly I tap my chess pieces, knocking ash from the lamp's wick.
-- Song Dynasty. Zhao Shixiu, "Waiting for a Guest"
Sorrento sits on the Mediterranean, the loveliest town at the northern end of Italy's Amalfi Coast in southern Italy. Along its coastal cliffs stand rows of villas and stone-paved streets, quiet and unhurried. Where there is sea breeze there are gardens; where there are waves there are fishing boats — it is a place for summer holidays. Across the water one can gaze at Mount Vesuvius in the distance. Sorrento owes much of its fame to the Italian folk song "Come Back to Sorrento."
"Come Back to Sorrento," Italian folk song
"Come Back, O Sorrento!" — Chinese lyrics by Xiao Erhua
Listen to the breathing of the sea, full of tender, sweet feeling;
your laughter and your song remain deep in my heart.
Within the garden the sunlight is radiant, chrysanthemums release their fragrance everywhere;
facing such beautiful spring scenery, how could I not think of you?
Ever since you and I parted, sorrow has flooded into my heart;
in this lovely place, I count the days until your return.
Come back, come back — please do not forget me.
Come back, come back — please do not forget me.
